paragraphs: Rabbi Yosna is mentioned at Hyman’s Avodah Zarah 36b citation [compare 33b:6]: Rabbi Yosna said in the name of Rabbi Ami.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied locator is לו:, rendered 36b. The corresponding Yosna–Ami statement is at Avodah Zarah 33b:6 in the William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic, which explicitly writes Rabbi for both names. This supports these title expansions and transmission formula, while leaving Hyman’s 36b unchanged.

The supplied heading יוסנא is retained as Yosna; an earlier heading audit offered יוסטנא, Yostna. The digital text comparison does not establish whether the locator or heading differences originated in print or transcription.
